title: Home guide: the card and glass trick (air pressure)
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: Muscles and bones (7C); the particle model (7G)
source: Written for science/y7 lesson 31 (Home practical guide and safety card: card and glass (portal worksheet; over a sink or bowl))
intro: Read it all first, then do it with an adult nearby.

equipment: A piece of card bigger than the top of the glass
safety: Do it over a sink or a bowl
Use a plastic cup if you have one
An adult knows what you are doing and stays nearby
Clear a space; tidy up and wash your hands afterwards
method: Fill the glass to the brim with water.
Slide the card over the top so there is no air gap.
Hold the card and turn the glass upside down over the sink.
Let go of the card. What happens?
Explain: air particles push up on the card harder than the water pushes down.
